svg.title: Row-wise ShardedEmbeddingCollection: backward topology
svg.desc: Autograd traverses graph nodes saved by forward; nn.Module.backward is not called. Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. backward(JaggedTensor.values) activities [1-14] reassemble torch.split gradients with D2D copies reverse the two index_select operations activities [15-18] restore deduplication and row order gradient in output-rank order dedup restore first, then unbucketize restore launch reverse AllToAll All2All_Seq_Req_Wait.backward is asynchronous dummy-tensor edge schedules predecessor autograd now enters All2All_Seq_Req.backward req.wait() + receive wait for the reverse AllToAll, then decode gradient in local lookup order backward recat restores the TBE input layout generated sparse backward reduce repeated rows and update the local shard stop at integer sparse inputs input distribution was created under torch.no_grad
